description: This file defines the ConceptProposal class in the OpenMRS project, representing a proposal for a new medical concept that may be added to the system. It includes fields for tracking the proposal's state, related encounter, user information, and the concept details. The class is annotated for auditing and extends BaseOpenmrsObject, implying it is part of the core data model for managing concept proposals.

classes.name: ConceptProposal
classes.description: Represents a proposed new concept within the OpenMRS system, including metadata about its creation, modification, status, and related entities such as encounter, user, and concept details.

methods.name: getConceptProposalId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this concept proposal.

methods.name: setConceptProposalId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this concept proposal.

methods.name: getEncounter
methods.description: Returns the encounter associated with this concept proposal.

methods.name: setEncounter
methods.description: Associates an encounter with this concept proposal.

methods.name: getObsConcept
methods.description: Returns the observation concept linked to this proposal.

methods.name: setObsConcept
methods.description: Sets the observation concept for this proposal.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Returns the observation associated with this proposal.

methods.name: setObs
methods.description: Associates an observation with this proposal.

methods.name: getMappedConcept
methods.description: Returns the concept that this proposal is mapped to after approval.

methods.name: setMappedConcept
methods.description: Sets the mapped concept after proposal approval.

methods.name: getOriginalText
methods.description: Returns the original text entered by the user for the concept proposal.

methods.name: setOriginalText
methods.description: Sets the original text for the proposal.

methods.name: getFinalText
methods.description: Returns the final text of the concept proposal after review.

methods.name: setFinalText
methods.description: Sets the final text for the proposal.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to the proposal.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Adds comments to the proposal.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the proposal (e.g., pending, rejected).

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the state of the proposal.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the user who created the proposal.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the creator of the proposal.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who last changed the proposal.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who last modified the proposal.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the proposal was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last modification.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the last modification timestamp.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the proposal, primarily its ID.

methods.name: rejectConceptProposal
methods.description: Marks this proposal as rejected and clears the final text. Requires saving the object afterward.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Gets the unique identifier of the object, as required by OpenMRS base class.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the object, as required by OpenMRS base class.
